notes: LA is a car city, so a rental car is essential (parking 20-40 USD). The Metro B Line is useful between Hollywood and Downtown. An Uber between the coast and the city costs 20-40 USD.
Summer is 28°C and dry, with morning fog on the coast (June gloom). The beaches are warmest from June to September (sea 20°C), and Universal is crowded.
The Getty and the Broad are free (reservation required); Griffith is free; Universal costs 109+ USD.
Tacos cost 3-5 USD (Guisados, Leo's), In-N-Out 10 USD, restaurants 30-50 USD. Tip 18-20%, and 9.5% tax is not included in the listed price.
Take the DASH bus up to Griffith (the car park fills up) and arrive 1 hour before sunset.
The sea is cold (18-20°C) with waves and currents, so watch for the lifeguard flags.

stops.name: Hollywood Walk of Fame
stops.tips: See the handprints and stars at the TCL Chinese Theatre; the crowds are thinner in the morning.

stops.name: Hollywood Sign Seyir Noktası Lake Hollywood Park
stops.tips: The closest free spot to see the sign. Take your photos here.

stops.name: Grand Central Market
stops.tips: A market open since 1917. Try Eggslut, Tacos Tumbras a Tomas and Sarita's pupusas.

stops.name: The Broad
stops.tips: A free contemporary art museum. Book online for the Infinity Mirror room.

stops.name: Griffith Observatory
stops.tips: A free observatory with sunset and city lights views. The car park fills up, so take the DASH bus.

backups.name: Musso & Frank Grill
backups.tips: Hollywood's restaurant since 1919. Order a martini.

backups.name: Walt Disney Concert Hall
backups.tips: Gehry's silver building. The garden tour is free.

stops.name: Santa Monica Pier
stops.tips: The end of Route 66. Ride the Pacific Park Ferris wheel (~15 USD).

stops.name: Santa Monica Beach
stops.tips: Summer sun. There are no loungers, so bring a towel and sunscreen. The sea is 20°C.

stops.name: Venice Beach Boardwalk
stops.tips: Muscle Beach, street performers and the skate park.

stops.name: Gjusta Venice
stops.tips: Venice's cult bakery-cafe. Try the smoked fish and the bread.

stops.name: Venice Canals
stops.tips: Canals and bridges dating from 1905. A quiet walk.

backups.name: Abbot Kinney Boulevard
backups.tips: Boutiques and coffee. An alternative to the canals.

stops.name: Getty Center
stops.tips: A free museum (parking 20 USD, reservation required). See Van Gogh's Irises, the gardens and the city views. Take the tram up.

stops.name: Getty Center Garden Terrace Cafe
stops.tips: The museum cafe, with garden views.

stops.name: Rodeo Drive
stops.tips: Beverly Hills' luxury street. Go window shopping.

stops.name: Beverly Gardens Park
stops.tips: The Beverly Hills sign and a cactus garden.

stops.name: In-N-Out Burger Sunset
stops.tips: A California classic. Order a Double-Double animal style from the secret menu.

backups.name: Nate 'n Al's Beverly Hills
backups.tips: A deli since 1945. Try the pastrami.

backups.name: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
backups.tips: The Urban Light lamps. An alternative to the Getty.

stops.name: Bradbury Building
stops.tips: The iron atrium from Blade Runner. The lobby is free.

stops.name: Angels Flight Railway
stops.tips: The world's shortest railway, on Bunker Hill.

stops.name: Little Tokyo
stops.tips: The Japanese Village Plaza and the Japanese American National Museum.

stops.name: Sushi Gen Little Tokyo
stops.tips: A sashimi lunch set. A queue forms by 11:15.

stops.name: Koreatown BBQ Kang Ho-dong Baekjeong
stops.tips: Korean BBQ in K-town. Some branches are open 24 hours.

backups.name: Arts District
backups.tips: Murals and breweries, next to Little Tokyo.

backups.name: Langer's Delicatessen
backups.tips: The #19 pastrami sandwich since 1947, by MacArthur Park.

stops.name: Malibu Pier
stops.tips: A 45-minute drive along the PCH. Have breakfast on the pier at Malibu Farm.

stops.name: El Matador State Beach
stops.tips: Summer mornings start with fog (June gloom), then sun. It gets crowded at midday.

stops.name: Malibu Seafood
stops.tips: A roadside fish counter. Order fish and chips and sit at the tables with PCH views.

stops.name: Point Dume
stops.tips: A walk along the headland. Look for whales in season (December to April) and seals.

stops.name: Getty Villa
stops.tips: A free museum of ancient art. A good indoor stop when it's hot.

backups.name: Neptune's Net
backups.tips: A seafood classic with a biker crowd, on the PCH.

backups.name: Zuma Beach
backups.tips: A wide beach. An alternative to El Matador.

stops.name: Universal Studios Hollywood
stops.tips: The Studio Tour (Jaws, Psycho) and Super Nintendo World. A one-day ticket is ~109 USD, so buy online. Get the Express pass when it's crowded.

stops.name: Universal CityWalk
stops.tips: Restaurants by the park exit, plus Voodoo Doughnut.

stops.name: Warner Bros. Studio Tour Seyir
stops.tips: The Burbank studio gate. The tour is separate and takes place the next day (~70 USD).

backups.name: Warner Bros. Studio Tour
backups.tips: A tour of a real working studio. A calmer option than Universal.

backups.name: Pink's Hot Dogs
backups.tips: A hot dog stand since 1939, on La Brea.

stops.name: Silver Lake Reservoir Yürüyüşü
stops.tips: A 3.5 km walk around the reservoir, with plenty of neighbourhood dogs.

stops.name: Micheltorena Stairs
stops.tips: The heart-shaped stairs. Take a Silver Lake photo.

stops.name: Intelligentsia Coffee Silver Lake
stops.tips: LA's third-wave coffee, with a courtyard.

stops.name: Guisados Echo Park
stops.tips: Braised tacos. Order the sampler plate as your farewell meal.

stops.name: LAX FlyAway Union Station
stops.tips: The bus from Union Station to LAX takes 45 minutes. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Pine & Crane Silver Lake
backups.tips: Taiwanese cuisine. An alternative to tacos.

backups.name: Echo Park Lake
backups.tips: A lotus pond and pedal boats. An alternative to the reservoir.
